definitions.explanation: An airline route or flight that operates within the borders of a single country. Most commonly refers to flights but also covers the terminal area handling them.

examples.japanese: {国内線|こくないせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧です。
examples.english: The domestic terminal is this way.

examples.japanese: {国内線|こくないせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'll take a domestic flight to Osaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{国内線|こくないせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠航|けっこう}→欠航：09509_kekkou⟧になった。
examples.english: Because of the typhoon, many domestic flights were cancelled.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧ (domestic) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line; route). Used for airlines and occasionally trains, but the airline sense dominates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国内線|こくないせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take a domestic flight
- {国内線|こくないせん}⟦ターミナル→ターミナル：11037_taaminaru⟧: domestic terminal
- {国内線|こくないせん}⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧: domestic-only
- {国内線|こくないせん}⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: domestic booking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国際線|こくさいせん}→国際線：27502_kokusaisen⟧: international flight — the counterpart for flights that cross national borders
- {国内便|こくないびん}: domestic flight — refers to a specific flight rather than the route as a whole
